issue_context.title: Translate button ignores poll options
issue_context.body: ### Steps to reproduce the problem 1. Create a post with some poll options 2. Click "Translate" to translate it into another language ### Expected behaviour Both the text and poll options should be translated ### Actual behaviour Only the post text is translated, while poll options remain in their original language ### Detailed description Translating posts that contain polls doesn't seem to translate the latter. Before: After: As you can see German options remained untranslated ### Specifications Mastodon 4.0.2

review_comments: I see no reason rename this, you can just add everything to this one.
That doesn't sound right. For `content` and `spoiler_text`, the key would just be that. Poll options can be edited, and so can media attachment descriptions.

Only the keys are transformed. The result is e.g. this: ```json { "content": "

This is content

", "Poll::Option-0": "Option 1", "Poll::Option-1": "Option 2", } ```
oh yeah, sorry, that does sound correct then
You added a new option, I think it should be documented in the documentation comment at the start of the class.
